entries.08fcc572d44028f2: This business sets up Japan Career Centers within universities in India through partnerships with Indian universities, and matches students who receive ICT education in India and wish to work for Japanese companies with Japanese companies struggling with a shortage of engineering talent. Main revenue comes from placement fees and Japanese-language education fees. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, the company held 56 recruitment events (8 more than the prior year), and 149 people received job offers (25 more than the prior year). Job offer recipients receive about one year of Japanese-language education before joining the company.

entries.90f7af5a04c0f46e: Having been appointed as the Asia general agent for an American university scholarship program, this business mainly arranges regular study at US universities and study abroad aimed at earning overseas university degrees. It also arranges regular high school study in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand, exchange study at US high schools, and support for overseas study assignments mainly for young and mid-career employees of companies. It also focuses on study abroad dispatch to Southeast Asia, such as Malaysia, where demand has risen partly due to the weak yen. Main revenue comes from placement fees.

entries.942bd3129f71dc0d: A business that produces and operates 'specialized customer acquisition media' (specialized WEB media) so that users searching for clients' products or services can find them. Its main clients are companies handling highly specialized, niche products, such as BtoB (for businesses) items like liquid filling machines, stirring and defoaming machines, and high-speed cameras. The annual securities report states that it has produced and operated more than 8,400 specialized media to date. Its main revenue consists of production fees for newly produced media and operation fees received every month on a continuing basis for operation and maintenance. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,768,195 thousand (up 1.6% year on year), and segment profit was ¥979,175 thousand (up 3.2%), the largest of the 3 reportable segments. In this period, the number of new publications fell to 231 (down 62 from the previous year) and the number of operated media fell to 931 (down 47), but revenue increased as the company advanced into and strengthened the human capital marketing field, which supports strengthened recruitment capability and improved employee engagement.

entries.cc3e90610414e389: This business mainly provides language training to companies, in content commissioned by clients. It offers courses such as TOEIC preparation, business English and intensive courses just before overseas assignments. Most course content is developed in-house, and instructors are hired only if they have experience and have completed prior training. In addition to dispatching instructors to offices and training facilities, it also provides online lessons and runs online English conversation for junior high and high school students. Main revenue comes from tuition and textbook fees.
entries.cfcf67cba973b065: This business introduces overseas talent, mainly from India and Indonesia, to Japanese companies in the nursing care, lodging and food service industries, among others, as Specified Skilled Workers and other categories, and also supports their settling in. In nursing care, it also provides the five-year language education program 'ZENKEN NIHONGO Kaigo', which aims at acquiring the Certified Care Worker (kaigo fukushishi) qualification needed to keep working in Japan over the long term. It operates a nursing care facility in Kuki City, Saitama Prefecture, acquired in July 2022, with the aim of making it a role model for utilizing overseas nursing care talent. It is also commissioned by Tottori, Ibaraki and Niigata prefectures, among others, to provide matching support for foreign nursing care talent and support for obtaining national qualifications. Main revenue comes from placement fees, registration support fees and Japanese-language education fees.
